channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: HANTIDHOWRKA GUUD EE SOOMAALIYA OO XOOJINAYA HUFNAANTA IYO LA XISAABTANKA MAAMULKA KHAYRAADKA DABIICIGA AH EE DALKA
item.description: Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta qabtay kulan aqoon-is-weydaarsi ah oo diiradda lagu saaray maareynta, soo saarista iyo maamulka khayraadka dabiiciga ah ee dalka, iyadoo ujeeddadu tahay xoojinta hufnaanta, isla-xisaabtanka iyo ilaalinta hantida qaranka.

item.title: Anthropic oo suuqa Nasdaq ku biirtay, iibkeedii saamiyada ayaa noqday kii ugu weynaa taariikhda
item.description: Shirkadda sirdoonka macmalka ah ee Mareykanka Anthropic ayaa 19 November saamiyadeeda ka bilowday suuqa Nasdaq, kaddib markii ay iibisay 980 milyan oo saami oo midkiiba yahay 83 doollar, taasoo ka dhigtay iibka ugu horreeya ee ugu weyn taariikhda.

item.title: Premier League oo shaacisay taariikhaha xilli ciyaareedka 2027-28: 13 August ilaa 21 May
item.description: Premier League ayaa 19 November ku dhawaaqday in xilli ciyaareedka 2027-28 uu bilaaban doono Jimce, 13 August 2027, wareegga ugu dambeeyana uu wada dhici doono Axad, 21 May 2028.

item.title: England oo kooxda bilowga ku soo celisay Furbank, Chessum iyo Atkinson ka hor kulanka New Zealand
item.description: Tababaraha England Steve Borthwick ayaa 19 November shaaciyay kooxda ka ciyaari doonta kulanka Sabtida ee New Zealand ee tartanka Nations Championship ee rugby-ga, isagoo dib ugu soo celiyay George Furbank, Ollie Chessum iyo Seb Atkinson.

item.title: Didier Digard oo shirkiisii ugu horreeyay ee Lens ka sheegay inuu doonayo inuu kooxda dib ugu soo celiyo jidka
item.description: Tababaraha cusub ee RC Lens Didier Digard ayaa 19 November qabtay shirkiisii jaraa'id ee ugu horreeyay, laba maalmood ka hor kulankiisa koowaad ee kooxda oo ay la ciyaarayso Toulouse wareegga 11-aad ee Ligue 1.

item.title: Ireland oo kabtanka Dan Sheehan u dhigtay lambarka 8 kulanka South Africa
item.description: Tababaraha Ireland Andy Farrell ayaa 19 November kabtanka kooxda Dan Sheehan u magacaabay booska lambarka 8 ee kulanka Sabtida ay Dublin kula ciyaarayaan horyaalka adduunka South Africa, tartanka Nations Championship ee rugby-ga.

item.title: Putin oo diiday wadahadal xabbad-joojin ah kaddib weerarrada Ukraine ee buundada Crimea
item.description: Madaxweynaha Ruushka Vladimir Putin ayaa 19 November ku dhawaaqay in Moscow aysan galayn wadahadal xabbad-joojin ah kaddib weerarrada Ukraine ay ku qaadday buundada Crimea, isagoo ballanqaaday jawaab uu ku tilmaamay mid aad uga xanuun badan.

item.title: Koobka Adduunka ee da'da ka yar 17 oo ka bilaabmay Qatar, 48 xul ayaa ka qaybgalaya
item.description: Koobka Adduunka ee FIFA ee ciyaartoyda da'doodu ka yar tahay 17 sano ayaa 19 November ka furmay Qatar, iyadoo 48 xul ay ka qaybgalayaan, in kasta oo Mareykanku toddobaadkii hore ka baxay tartanka walaac amni dartiis.

item.title: Kooxaha Premier League oo ogolaaday inay bixiyaan kharashka sharciga haddii taageerayaasha Man City ay dacwad furaan
item.description: Kooxaha Premier League ayaa 19 November London ugu codeeyay inay daboolaan kharashka sharciga ee shanta agaasime ee golaha ururka haddii shirkadaha maalgeliya Manchester City ay dacwad ka gudbiyaan.

item.title: Samia iyo Museveni oo Uganda ka furay warshad gaadiid culus oo 4,000 baabuur sannadkii soo saari karta
item.description: Madaxweynaha Tanzania Samia Suluhu Hassan iyo Madaxweynaha Uganda Yoweri Museveni ayaa 19 November si wadajir ah u daahfuray warshadda isku-dubbaridka gaadiidka ee Double Q oo ku taalla Nakirebe, degmada Mpigi.

item.title: Hoggaamiyeyaal Yurub ah oo warqad cabasho ah u diray FIFA, kuna dalbaday dukumentiyada qorshihii Koobka Adduunka
item.description: Saddex ku-xigeen guddoomiye iyo shan xubnood oo ka tirsan Golaha FIFA ayaa warqad u diray xoghayaha guud ee FIFA Mattias Grafström, iyagoo dalbaday dukumentiyada qorshihii Gianni Infantino ee la xiriiray in qayb ka mid ah Koobka Adduunka loo wareejiyo maalgashadayaal gaar ah.

item.title: Emiliano Martínez oo ku baaqay in la jaraynayo qiimaha tigidhada xulka Argentina kaddib ka tagitaankii Messi
item.description: Goolhayaha xulka Argentina Emiliano Martínez ayaa ku baaqay in la dhimo qiimaha tigidhada kulamada xulka, kaddib markii tirada taageerayaasha garoomada timaada ay hoos u dhacday labadii kulan ee ugu horreeyay tan iyo markii Lionel Messi uu xulka ka fariistay.

item.title: Real Madrid oo heshiiska Aurélien Tchouaméni u kordhisay ilaa 2032
item.description: Real Madrid ayaa Khamiistii si rasmi ah u shaacisay inay heshiiska khadka dhexe ee Faransiiska Aurélien Tchouaméni u kordhisay ilaa 30 June 2032.

item.title: Beledweyne: Macawisleyda oo la wareegay garoonka Ugaas Khaliif, kana hortagtay ciidamo laga keenayay Muqdisho
item.description: Ciidamada deegaanka ee loo yaqaan Macawisley ayaa Khamiistii gudaha u galay garoonka diyaaradaha Ugaas Khaliif ee magaalada Beledweyne, kaddib markii la ogaaday diyaarad ciidamo dowladda federaalka ka soo qaadaysa Muqdisho.

item.title: Maxkamadda ICJ oo go'aamisay in Myanmar ay xasuuq ka gashay Rohingya, go'aan taariikhi ah
item.description: Maxkamadda Caddaaladda Caalamiga ah (ICJ) ayaa Khamiistii go'aamisay in Myanmar ay xasuuq ka geysatay dadka laga tirada badan yahay ee Rohingya, iyadoo codad 9 ka dhan 6 ah lagu gaaray go'aankan.

item.title: Carlos Alcaraz oo baaritaan MRI ah loo sameeyay kaddib dhaawac bowdada ah oo ka soo gaaray ATP Finals
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka tennis-ka Carlos Alcaraz ayaa Khamiistii magaalada Turin baaritaan MRI ah loogu sameeyay si loo ogaado heerka dhaawac uu ka qabo murqaha gadaal ee bowdada bidix, kaddib kulankii uu ATP Finals kaga adkaaday Daniil Medvedev.

item.title: Soomaaliya oo cayrisay safiirka Imaaraadka, diblomaasiyiinta Imaaraadkana la siiyay 72 saacadood
item.description: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa Khamiistii 19 November cayrisay safiirka Imaaraadka Carabta ee Muqdisho, iyadoo warbixinnada ay sheegayaan in diblomaasiyiinta Imaaraadka la siiyay 72 saacadood inay dalka uga baxaan.

item.title: Baarlamaanka Denmark oo ansixiyay heshiiska amniga Greenland ee lala galay Mareykanka
item.description: Baarlamaanka Denmark ayaa Khamiistii 19 November codad 109 ka dhan 0 ah ku ansixiyay heshiis amni oo Mareykanka u oggolaanaya inuu ballaariyo joogitaankiisa milatari ee Greenland.

item.title: WAR CUSUB: Madasha Samatabixinta oo caawa go’aan ka gaaraysa codsiga wada-hadalka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh
item.description: Golaha Madasha Samatabixinta Soomaaliyeed ayaa la filayaa in caawa saacadda 7:30 fiidnimo uu yeesho kulan xasaasi ah oo looga arrinsanayo farriin uu soo diray Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud.

item.title: Pochettino oo ka hor kulanka Anfield ugu baaqay Manchester United inay cabsi la'aan ciyaaraan
item.description: Tababaraha cusub ee Manchester United Mauricio Pochettino ayaa 19 November wareysigiisii ugu horreeyay ku sheegay inuu doonayo inuu xaaladda kooxda beddelo, isagoo ciyaartoydiisa ugu baaqay inaysan cabsan marka ay Axadda booqdaan Liverpool.

item.title: SOOMAALIYA IYO IMAARAADKA CARABTA: KHILAAF DIBLOMAASIYADEED OO SII XOOGAYSANAYA
item.description: Khilaafka Muqdisho iyo Abu Dhabi oo galay marxalad cusub, iyadoo la hadal hayo dib u yeerista safiirrada labada dal

item.title: Kompany oo sheegay inuu caafimaad qabo, Jimcaha ayuu dib ugu laabanayaa kursiga tababaraha Bayern
item.description: Tababaraha Bayern Munich Vincent Kompany ayaa Khamiistii sheegay inuu caafimaad fiican qabo, wuxuuna Jimcaha hoggaamin doonaa kooxda kulanka Bundesliga ee Köln, ku dhawaad bil kaddib markii uu xarunta tababarka ku suuxay.

item.title: Éver Banega, oo Sevilla la qaaday saddex Europa League, oo ka fariistay kubadda cagta
item.description: Khadka dhexe ee reer Argentina Éver Banega, oo 38 jir ah, ayaa ku dhawaaqay inuu si buuxda uga fariistay kubadda cagta, kaddib in ka badan toddobo bilood oo uusan kulan ciyaarin.

item.title: DEG DEG: Axmed Madoobe oo dhaliil culus u jeediyay Xasan Sheekh – “Xamar la iskuma aaminayo, talana la iskuma tagayo!”
item.description: Madaxweynaha Dowlad Goboleedka Jubbaland, Axmed Maxamed Islaam (Axmed Madoobe), ayaa dhaliil kulul u jeediyay Madaxweynaha Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, isaga oo si cad u muujiyay sida uu uga soo horjeedo habka uu u wajahayo arrimaha siyaasadeed ee dalka.

item.title: Irene Cheptai oo loo aqoonsaday horyaalka Sydney Marathon kaddib markii Jepchirchir laga qaaday
item.description: Orodyahanadda Kenya Irene Cheptai ayaa noqotay horyaalka haweenka ee Sydney Marathon 2026, kaddib markii Peres Jepchirchir laga xayuubiyay guushii, iyadoo la mamnuucay saddex sano arrimo daroogo awgood.

item.title: Espanyol oo waayay Àlex Calatrava: ciyaaryahanka khadka dhexe oo ka dillaacay seedda jilibka
item.description: Kooxda Espanyol ayaa xaqiijisay in ciyaaryahankeeda khadka dhexe Àlex Calatrava, oo loo yaqaan 'Cala', uu ka dillaacay seedda hore ee jilibka bidix (ACL) intii lagu jiray tababar, isla markaana qalliin lagu sameyn doono Talaadada soo socota.

item.title: Taliye-ku-xigeenka Booliska Soomaaliya, Sareeye Guuto Cabdalla Cabdalla, oo is casilay kuna biiray mucaaradka
item.description: Sareeye Guuto Cabdalla Cabdalla Maxamed, oo ahaa Taliye-ku-xigeenka Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed iyo Taliyaha Hawlgallada Gaarka ah, ayaa 19 November ku dhawaaqay inuu iska casilay xilalkiisa, isagoo hay'adaha amniga ku eedeeyay caddaalad-darro iyo eex.

item.title: Peres Jepchirchir, horyaalka adduunka ee marathonka, oo saddex sano laga mamnuucay orodka doping dartiis
item.description: Hay'adda Daacadnimada Orodka (AIU) ayaa 19 November saddex sano ka mamnuucday orodyahanadda Kenya Peres Jepchirchir, oo haysata horyaalka adduunka ee marathonka, kaddib markii baaritaan lagu helay daawada EPO, waxaana laga qaaday guushii marathonka Sydney.

item.title: Ash Barty oo loo doortay Hoolka Sharafta ee Tennis-ka Caalamiga ah
item.description: Ciyaartoyda Australia ee hore u ahayd kaalinta koowaad adduunka Ash Barty ayaa 19 November loo doortay International Tennis Hall of Fame, waxaana si rasmi ah loogu darayaa xaflad ka dhici doonta Rhode Island bisha August sannadka soo socda.

item.title: Dhismaha sanduuqa maalgashiga Sacuudiga ee Riyadh oo waxyeello gaartay kaddib weerarro cusub oo Xuutiyiinta
item.description: Dhismo dheer oo ku yaalla caasimadda Sacuudiga ee Riyadh, oo ay xarun u tahay Sanduuqa Maalgashiga Dadweynaha (PIF), ayaa 19 November waxyeello gaartay, kaddib markii isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo sheegay inuu ka hortagay gantaallo ay Xuutiyiintu ku ganeen Riyadh iyo koonfurta dalka.
